 Number of flood evacuees drops in Perak, rises in Selangor

 Floods: Situation worsens in Selangor and Negri Sembilan, improves in Perak 
 KUALA LUMPUR: The number of flood evacuees rose in Selangor on Thursday (Nov 19) morning but declined in Perak.
 In SELANGOR, the number of evacuees at relief centres increased to 1,583 from 416 families this morning, up from 1,392 from 372 families yesterday afternoon.
 According to the Social Welfare Department's (JKM) InfoBencana portal, SK Dato' Maharaja Lela housed the highest number of evacuees at 369, followed by SK Parit Mahang (338), Sekolah Rendah Agama (SRA) Bukit Kuching (238), Dewan Masjid An Naim Kampung Jalan Kebun (219), Dewan Orang Ramai Bukit Kuching Tengah (103) and SK Sungai Binjai (101).
 Another 63 evacuees were sheltered at Dewan Orang Ramai Seri Harmoni, Kafa Integrasi Hidayah Bukit Cherakah (58), SRA Batu 8 Ijok (43), Dewan Orang Ramai Kampung Jaya Sepakat (31) and SK Batu Arang (20).
 In PERAK, the State Disaster Management Committee Secretariat said the number of evacuees at eight relief centres across five districts had dropped to 681 from 239 families this morning, compared with 701 from 241 families yesterday afternoon.
 Perak Tengah became the latest district affected by floods, with two relief centres opening yesterday. SK Dato' Sagor is sheltering 22 people from five families, while SK Tanjung Belanja is housing 40 people from 23 families.
 In Larut, Matang and Selama, 207 evacuees from 79 families remain at SK Batu Hampar and SK Matang, while 131 evacuees from 39 families are staying at Sekolah Rendah Agama Rakyat Padang Serai in Manjung.
 In Hilir Perak, 108 people from 34 families remain at relief centres, while Kerian has 161 evacuees from 56 families, including 12 landslide victims from three families, at SK Bukit Merah and SK Parit Haji Aman.
 The Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) has forecast thunderstorms and rain across all districts in Perak this afternoon and tonight.
 Meanwhile, the Perak Drainage and Irrigation Department reported that the water level of Sungai Kurau at the Bukit Merah Reservoir in Kerian stood at 9.18 metres, above the danger level and higher than the normal reading of 8.68 metres.
 In NEGRI SEMBILAN, two relief centres in Port Dickson, namely Balai Raya Kampung Jimah Lama and Balai Raya Kampung Linggi, are housing 61 people from 17 families this morning, a slight increase from 60 yesterday. - Bernama
